name: Silver-plated dachshund figure
identification_notes: The genuine Hermès silver-plate dachshunds that show up for sale are photo-frame holders and letter openers made by Ercuis for Hermès, and they carry Hermès Paris marks. A catalogue note of 'Hermès style' and no mark suggests it is not genuine. Check the underside for 'HERMES PARIS' or Ercuis marks before pricing it as genuine.
